lines.t: No lies of the truth
It fades like morning dew
The world turns hearts to shadows
but his word makes all things new be separate oh children from the ways of pride and gain
let righteousness be your garment and holiness remain
fever the breath that came down from heaven the true bread unbroken and shaken the way
The truth, the life everlasting
And this alone is the joy
Of the Father found
No more speak lies to your children
Not even little white lies
For even the smallest shadow dims
The light before their eyes
Order your conduct in mercy
Let love be your guide
For the word of the Lord is living
In Him abide
Feet in the breath that came down from heaven
The true bread broken, unshaken
The way, the truth, the life everlasting
And this alone is the joy of the Father found
Anything contrary is of the world's disguise
The mask of the evil one is hidden in its lies
Yet light pierces darkness, his people stand apart
Consecrated by the Spirit, the truth within their heart
Feed them the bread that came down from heaven
The true bread unbroken and shaken
The way, the truth, the life everlasting
And this alone is the joy
Of the Father found
Found, found, found, found, found, found
The lies of the truth
So walk in what is pure
The word eternal spoken
Forever shall endure
Thank you.
